source.name: Citroën Racing: Citroën unveils the single-seater that will carry its colours in Formula E
source.quote: Citroën unveils the single-seater that will carry the brand’s colours during its official participation in the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship.
source.note: Team's own launch release (dateline Poissy, 20 October 2025; published on the team site under 01 Dec 2025). Citroën is the manufacturer brand the team is named after — Citroën Racing Formula E Team — so it takes the front slot, as CUPRA does for Cupra Kiro and DS Automobiles for DS Penske.

source.name: MFE-Live (Marie-France Estenave): Mitsubishi Electric est partenaire officiel de Citroën Racing pour la saison 2025-2026 de Formule E
source.quote: Mitsubishi Electric accompagne l’entrée du Citroën Racing Formula E Team dans l’unique compétition de monoplaces électriques au monde.
source.note: French: 'Mitsubishi Electric accompanies the Citroën Racing Formula E Team's entry into the world's only electric single-seater competition.' Cross-checked on Mitsubishi Electric's own campaign site (electric-race.mitsubishielectric.fr): 'Mitsubishi Electric est sponsor officiel de Citroën Racing !'.

summary: Citroën — the Stellantis marque the team is named after — leads the kit, and Mitsubishi Electric is the team partner announced for the debut Season 12 (22 Oct 2025). The team site's partners block (checked 2026-10-03) lists only Mitsubishi Electric and TotalEnergies, and the TotalEnergies release says it is a partner 'from Season 13' (23 Sep 2026), so it is not on this kit. No other Season 12 team-partner announcement was found.
